bias.en: Bearish · broke the 200-day, SAR flipped bearish
bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 200 日均线，SAR 转空

read.en: SanDisk fell 13.5% on Oct 30 to $1,150.89, its lowest close since Jul 29, trading between $1,115.23 and $1,239.00 on 2.1 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,289.2), 10-day ($1,306.0), 30-day ($1,535.6) and 100-day ($1,606.5) averages and the rising 200-day ($1,259.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram widening again; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 30 ($1,408.45), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: 闪迪 10月30日大跌 13.5%，收于 $1,150.89，为 7月29日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $1,115.23–1,239.00，成交量为均量的 2.1 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$1,289.2）、10 日（$1,306.0）、30 日（$1,535.6）和 100 日均线（$1,606.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$1,259.2）下方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图再度扩大；抛物线 SAR 于 10月30日转为看空（$1,408.45），RSI 为 33。

read.en: Two down days broke all three written supports ($1,343.9, $1,325–1,327, $1,287.8–1,300) and the 200-day, and flipped the SAR bearish. Resistance is $1,229–1,239 (Oct 23 and 26 lows, Oct 30 high), then $1,259.2 (200-day) and $1,289–1,306 (5 and 10-day). Support is $1,115–1,121 (Oct 30 and Aug 3 lows), then $1,048–1,051 (Jul 28 and May 1 lows) and $998.2 (Jul 29 low). A close above $1,259 would target $1,290–1,306; below $1,115, $1,050.

r.en: Oct 23 and Oct 26 lows ($1,228.9–1,229); Oct 30 high $1,239
